projects.attachment_error_too_many: You can attach at most {max} files.
projects.attachment_error_type: The file "{name}" cannot be uploaded - the type {ext} is not allowed.
projects.attachment_error_size: The file "{name}" is too large (max {maxMb} MB).
projects.field_email_label: Contact e-mail (also used for customer activity notifications)
projects.project_created_message: The project was created. Its Access part opens now – add the client users (by an invitation e-mail or a password).
projects.password_visibility_hint: The password is shown only now. Copy it and send it to the client – after hiding it, leaving or reloading the page you cannot show it again (it is stored nowhere). A forgotten password is solved by a reset.
projects.close_uncopied_password_message: You did not copy the password. It cannot be shown again – if the client does not have it yet, you will have to reset the password.
projects.threads_empty: The customer hasn't started any thread yet.
projects.password_copied_message: Password has been copied to the clipboard.
projects.url_copied_message: Public link has been copied to the clipboard.
projects.detail_not_found: The project does not exist or was deleted.
projects.detail_select_thread: Select a conversation on the left.
projects.detail_readonly: You are not allowed to edit the project – the settings are read-only.
projects.detail_unsaved_message: The project settings have unsaved changes. Do you really want to leave and discard them?
projects.checkpoint_description_placeholder: What the checkpoint covers – e.g. individual tasks or deliverables…
projects.checkpoint_description_hint: The customer sees the description in the portal when expanding the checkpoint.
projects.checkpoint_no_description: No description – the customer sees the title only.
projects.reply_internal_hint: Only the team sees an internal note in the administration – the client never sees it in the portal and gets no e-mail.
projects.checkpoint_internal_note_placeholder: E.g. waiting for materials, depends on the hosting…
projects.accounts_empty: The project has no user yet – the client cannot sign in to the portal. Add a user.
projects.account_username_hint: 3–64 characters: lower-case letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore. Unique within the project.
projects.account_notify_hint: The client turns e-mail notifications on and off in the portal (My account). Off by default. The e-mail never contains the message text.
projects.account_password_placeholder: Leave empty – a password is generated
projects.account_password_hint: Own password: at least 10 characters with letters and digits. The password is shown only once after saving.
projects.account_reset_confirm_message: A new password will be generated for {name}. The old one stops working and all their devices are signed out. Continue?
projects.account_remove_confirm_message: {name} loses access to the portal and all their devices are signed out. Their messages stay in the threads. Continue?
projects.access_details_copied_message: The link, login name and password were copied – paste them into a message for the client.
projects.files_empty: There are no files in the threads yet.
projects.account_email_hint: Only prefilled – the client can change the e-mail in the portal. The client turns notifications on; changing the e-mail turns them off.
projects.account_access_required: Choose a password or an invitation e-mail – otherwise the user cannot sign in.
projects.account_invite_confirm_message: {name} gets an invitation with a one-time sign-in link (valid 7 days) at {email}. An older unused link stops working. Continue?
projects.account_invite_failed_message: The user was created but the invitation e-mail could not be sent. Try again with the envelope button of the user.
projects.account_invited: Invited – not signed in by the link yet
projects.account_send_invitation_hint: The client gets an e-mail with a one-time link (valid 7 days) to sign in without a password. Later sign-ins use a code from the e-mail, or a password if you set one.
projects.account_send_invitation_needs_email: Fill in an e-mail for the invitation.
projects.account_with_password_hint: Type a password or let one be generated; it is shown once and you hand it over yourself.
projects.activity_empty: Nothing happened in the last 90 days.
projects.approval_cancel_confirm_message: The request "{title}" disappears from the client portal, the history of decisions stays. Continue?
projects.approval_reopen_confirm_message: The request "{title}" waits for approval again and clients with notifications get an e-mail. Continue?
projects.approval_delete_confirm_message: The request "{title}" and its files will be deleted permanently. Continue?
projects.approval_description_label: Description – what the client should review
projects.approval_description_placeholder: E.g. two logo variants, please pick one or write your comments.
projects.approval_notify_hint: After sending, the client sees the request in the portal under Approvals; users with notifications on get an e-mail.
projects.approval_edit_hint: Only a request waiting for a decision can be changed.
projects.approvals_empty_open: Nothing waits for the client's decision.
projects.approvals_lead: Requests to approve designs, texts or versions. The client approves or sends back with a comment in the portal; each decision is stored with the name and time.
projects.templates_lead: Prepared lists of steps a new project can start with or that you add to an existing project.
projects.template_delete_confirm_message: The template "{name}" will be deleted. Projects made from it keep their steps. Continue?
projects.template_offset_hint: Due date of a step = start date + number of days. Empty = a step without a date.
projects.template_apply_hint: The steps of the template are added at the end with the status Not started.
projects.template_save_hint: Saves the titles, descriptions and due dates of the steps (as days after the earliest date). Internal notes are not saved.
projects.update_delete_confirm_message: The update "{title}" and its files will be deleted permanently. Continue?
projects.update_publish_confirm_message: The client sees "{title}" in the portal; at the first publication users with notifications on get an e-mail. Continue?
projects.update_unpublish_confirm_message: The update "{title}" disappears from the client portal. Continue?
projects.update_publish_hint: Only the team sees a draft. The client sees a published update in the portal; an e-mail goes out only at the first publication.
projects.update_published_message: The update is published. E-mails sent to the client: {count}.
projects.update_body_placeholder: What we did, what comes next, what we need from you…
projects.updates_lead: Short news for the client about what was done on the project. The client sees them in the portal under Updates.

admin-layout.app_description_project_portal: Client projects, their client portal, templates and the portal log.

retention-settings.hint_projects: With threads, messages and attachments; the last portal message counts too.

permission-descriptions.web-projects-view: View the list and detail of customer projects
permission-descriptions.web-projects-create: Create a customer project (standalone or from an order)
permission-descriptions.web-projects-update: Edit a project, its checkpoints and client accounts and answer customer requests
permission-descriptions.view-project-portal: [recommended: always on] Show the Project portal application in the admin - without it the application cannot be opened
permission-descriptions.project-portal-view-logs: View the log history (audit trail) of the project portal
